title: Is taking a drop year for competitive exams worth it?
description: The debate weighs whether students should take a year after school to prepare again for competitive examinations such as JEE or NEET.

facts.fact: In March 2022 the National Medical Commission removed the upper age limit for NEET-UG, so students can sit the exam again after a drop year.
JEE Advanced allows a maximum of two attempts in two consecutive years, so a student who drops right after Class 12 still gets a second IIT attempt.
India had 1,18,190 MBBS seats for NEET-UG 2025 counselling, so a better rank after another year of preparation can decide who gets one.
In NEET-UG 2025, 12.36 lakh qualified candidates competed for just 1.18 lakh MBBS seats, so a repeat attempt does not guarantee admission.
A drop year can create financial costs and psychological pressure from delayed entry into college or employment.
Only students who first passed Class 12 in 2026 or 2027 can take JEE Advanced 2027, so more than one drop year ends IIT eligibility.
